scope: floating diagnostics for new non-square-root tau, not Cn; geometry and mechanism need independent proof and exact verification
objective: minimize log2 L among c >= 9/10 candidates while paying generic R085 target, face, weighted-cap and modified tau and full scalar remainder envelopes
each_worker: scipy differential_evolution; six continuous variables; popsize=7; maxiter=30; polish=false; hard bound <= 1302 evaluations per worker
variables: s, log10 chi-mu gap, log10 sigma gap above chi/(1+chi), log10(1-qmax), fractional delta interval, gamma allocation fraction; variables round to 8 decimals for candidate display and must be recertified
fixed_secondary: trim=1e-7; e=min(1e-5,(m*Ret-gamma)/(30m),(chi-mu)/20); m halfway gamma to log(rhi/rlo); Ret=1-min(.001,(m-gamma)/(4m)); m_face halfway [mu+2d_mu]/(1-e) to chi; safety ratio 1/2 for weighted-cap exponent
tau: tau=n exp(-delta L); tau/k <= rhi L^2 exp(-(delta-chi(1-sigma))L); complete scalar/n <= price-gamma+1/n+exp(-delta L)+exp(-sigma L)+L exp(-(sigma-delta)L)
precision: binary floating point log-domain optimization; no candidate certificate
resource: 15 worker processes, BLAS 1 thread each, sample aggregate worker RSS and CPU every 0.4s; do not allocate memory artificially
stop: 15 workers, finite exact bounded evaluations, one batch; stop once completed
